bends.reason: bend_01: the scan follows the orange profile. The strap leg stays in the plate plane for about 71 mm past the line, so the 90 deg CAD leg is missing. Raw TOP and ISO views show both straps running flat past both long plate edges. The hook at the strap end (foot plus lip) belongs to B10 and B11.

Bent in the REVERSE direction. bend_02: the scan follows the parent (the foot, which is flat because B3 is not formed) to about 4-5 mm past the line. It then folds about 115-120 deg, but the roughly 9 mm lip ends up on the OPPOSITE side of the parent plane from the blue lip. It is not flat, so it does not follow the orange profile. The raw SIDE view shows a single J-hook at this (B4/B12 side) strap end, curling toward the legs/B15 side. The CAD lip folds the other way relative to the foot (as on the B5/B11 end). Bent at this line but non-conforming, so any angle check must FAIL it. Flag for tiebreak.
